externalAgent.prompt:
Based on what you know about me, write a short introduction for my AI teacher. Include only:
- What you usually call me
- My work or study background, roles, and relevant experience
- My preferred expression style
- My preferred slide style
- What I am focusing on recently

Write in first-person plain text and keep it within 1,000 characters. Do not guess or add details you do not know.
